messages.message: ### Step 2: Morphosyntactic Requirement Definition Goal: For Malayalam, specify per-token morphosyntax needed to realize the Step 1 Interpretation Lock. Requirements (ONE Markdown table): - Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Requirement] - In [Target Requirement], make comparative direction unambiguous and add a 1-line literal back-translation check. Output: ONLY the table; no extra prose.

| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Requirement (Malayalam) | |-------------|----------------------|---------------------------------| | Nel | “in the middle of” – locative prepositional phrase introducing the central point | **മധ്യത്തില്‍** – noun *മധ്യം* + locative suffix **‑ല്‍**; back‑translation: “in middle” | | mezzo | “middle” – the central point of a span | **മധ്യം** (noun, neuter, singular); back‑translation: “middle” | | del | “of the” – genitive linking the road to the larger context | **‑യുടെ** (genitive suffix attached to *വഴി* → *വഴിയുടെ*); back‑translation: “of the” | | cammin | “road” – the route or way that one travels on; metaphor for life’s course | **വഴി** (noun, singular, nominative); back‑translation: “road” | | di | “of” – marks possession/association | **‑യുടെ** (genitive suffix on the following noun); back‑translation: “of” | | nostra | “our” – collective ownership of life | **ഞങ്ങളുടെ** (first‑person plural possessive pronoun + genitive suffix); back‑translation: “our” | | vita | “life” – the span of existence of the speaker | **ജീവിതം** (noun, neuter, singular, genitive when combined → *ജീവിതത്തിന്റെ*); back‑translation: “life” | | mi | reflexive pronoun “myself” (object) | **സ്വയം** (reflexive pronoun, emphatic) used with verb; back‑translation: “myself” | | ritrovai | “found” – act of discovering one’s own state | **കണ്ടെത്തി** (verb, 1st‑person singular, past perfective); back‑translation: “found” | | per | “within” – indicates interior location | **അകത്ത്** (postposition, locative); back‑translation: “within” | | una | “a” – indefinite article (non‑specific) | No article; noun appears bare (**കാട്**) – Malayalam lacks indefinite article; back‑translation: “a” (implicit) | | selva | “wood” – densely wooded area, metaphorically dark | **കാട്** (noun, singular); back‑translation: “wood” | | oscura | “dark” – lacking light, conveys gloom | **ഇരുണ്ട** (adjective, attributive, agrees with *കാട്*); back‑translation: “dark” | | ché | “for/because” – causal conjunction | **കാരണം** (causal conjunction placed after clause or as **എന്നാൽ**); back‑translation: “because” | | la | “the” – definite article (specifies particular way) | **ആ** (demonstrative determiner before *വഴി* → *ആ വഴി*); back‑translation: “the” | | diritta | “right” – correct or proper path | **ശരിയായ** (adjective, attributive, agrees with *വഴി*); back‑translation: “right” | | via | “way” – the correct route or method of proceeding | **വഴി** (noun, singular, nominative); back‑translation: “way” | | era | “had been” – past state of being (imperfect) | **ഇരുന്നതായിരുന്നു** (verb, 3rd‑person singular, past imperfect); back‑translation: “was” | | smarrita | “missed” – state of being lost or not found | **കാണാതായ** (past participle used adjectivally, agrees with *വഴി*); back‑translation: “missed” |

### Step 3: Pre-assembled Lexical Inventory Create placeable Malayalam components for Step 4. Output ONLY bullet list; ONE LINE per bullet. - Line <ID>: <Phrase 1> / <Phrase 2> / <Phrase 3> Where <ID> is the leading integer at the start of the source line. Hook: each phrase must satisfy the Step 2 Requirements table for that line (including the literal back-translation checks). Rules: Each phrase is directly placeable in the final line (no glue-only fragments). Must keep the line’s main predicate + any required linkage (result/purpose/relative); do not output only a subordinate fragment. Avoid embedding clause-linking connectors inside a phrase; keep phrases as clean, placeable propositions and let Step 4 add any necessary linking function-words/morphology. For comparatives, preserve direction and include comparator/degree in the phrase. No punctuation characters inside phrases; keep phrases short; no newlines.

- Line 1: ഞങ്ങളുടെ ജീവിതത്തിന്റെ വഴിയുടെ മധ്യത്തില്‍ / ഞങ്ങളുടെ ജീവിതവഴിയുടെ മധ്യത്തില്‍ / വഴിയുടെ മധ്യത്തില്‍ ഞങ്ങളുടെ ജീവിതം - Line 2: ഞാൻ ഇരുണ്ട കാട്ടിൽ താനെ കണ്ടെത്തി / ഞാൻ ഒരു ഇരുണ്ട കാട്ടിൽ താനെ കണ്ടെത്തി / ഞാൻ കാട്ടിന്റെ ഇരുണ്ട അകത്ത് താനെ കണ്ടെത്തി - Line 3: കാരണം ശരിയായ വഴി കാണാതായിരുന്നു / എന്നാൽ ശരിയായ വഴി കാണാതായിരുന്നു / കാരണം ശരിയായ വഴി നഷ്ടപ്പെട്ടിരുന്നു

### Step 4: Slot-Based Syntactic Assembly Assemble Step3 components into Malayalam lines; keep the same number of lines. Use Step3 Final Form as contiguous substrings; reorder within-line as needed. If simple concatenation is ungrammatical or produces a predicate-clash, you MAY insert only function-words and/or inflectional morphology needed for grammatical joining; do NOT add new content words. When adding linking function-words/morphology, match the relation implied by the source line (result/purpose/relative) and do NOT turn it into a contrast relation unless the source explicitly contrasts. Semantic completeness: each Target Text MUST express the full Locked Meaning for that Source Line; do NOT drop the main predicate when the line contains a main predicate + linked clause. Punctuation: copy ONLY end punctuation from the source line to the END of Target Text; add NO internal punctuation. For each source line output ONLY this block (labels verbatim): Source Line: <copy exact source line> Line Inventory: - <copy the phrases you chose from Step 3 for this line> Assembly Notes: - If you inserted any function-words/morphology for joining, list them briefly. Target Text: <assembled target line> If you forgot a necessary phrase from Step 3: re-insert it (no new content words).

**Source Line:** 1 Nel mezzo del cammin di nostra vita
**Line Inventory:** - ഞങ്ങളുടെ ജീവിതത്തിന്റെ വഴിയുടെ മധ്യത്തില്‍
**Assembly Notes:** - No additional function‑words needed; the phrase already conveys “midway on the road of our life”.
**Target Text:** ഞങ്ങളുടെ ജീവിതത്തിന്റെ വഴിയുടെ മധ്യത്തില്‍
---
**Source Line:** 2 mi ritrovai per una selva oscura,
**Line Inventory:** - ഞാൻ ഇരുണ്ട കാട്ടിൽ താനെ കണ്ടെത്തി
**Assembly Notes:** - No extra morphology required; the phrase includes the reflexive “found myself” and the locative “within a dark wood”.
**Target Text:** ഞാൻ ഇരുണ്ട കാട്ടിൽ താനെ കണ്ടെത്തി,
---
**Source Line:** 3 ché la diritta via era smarrita.
**Line Inventory:** - കാരണം ശരിയായ വഴി കാണാതായിരുന്നു
**Assembly Notes:** - Inserted causal conjunction “കാരണം” to match the Italian “ché”.
**Target Text:** കാരണം ശരിയായ വഴി കാണാതായിരുന്നു.

### Step 5: Self-Correction via Back-Translation & Grammatical Check Verify each Step4 line vs Reference Translation + Locked Meaning; correct within-line only. Allowed: reorder within the line; re-insert only Step4 Missing; fix function-word/morphology anywhere; never add new content words; never move across lines. Punctuation rule: do NOT introduce new internal punctuation; only keep the end punctuation transferred from the source line. Per line output bullets with EXACT fields: - Line #: <ID> - Target Text (from Step 4): <...> - Back-Translation (literal into the reference translation's language): <...> - Reference Translation (line-aligned): <...> - Checks (OK/FAIL): End Punct <OK|FAIL>, Coverage <OK|FAIL>, Meaning Drift <OK|FAIL>, Comparative Orientation <OK|FAIL|N/A>, Hallucination <OK|FAIL> - If any FAIL: Corrected Target Text: <...> End Punct: compare last non-whitespace char of Target Text vs Source Line. Line # rule: <ID> is the leading integer at the start of that Source Line. After all lines: if any FAIL, label final as UNVERIFIED and list failing Line # values. Output final Malayalam text in ONE code block, line by line.

- Line #: 1 - Target Text (from Step 4): ഞങ്ങളുടെ ജീവിതത്തിന്റെ വഴിയുടെ മധ്യത്തില്‍ - Back-Translation (literal into the reference translation's language): in the middle of our life's road - Reference Translation (line‑aligned): Midway upon the road of our life - Checks (OK/FAIL): End Punct **OK**, Coverage **OK**, Meaning Drift **OK**, Comparative Orientation **N/A**, Hallucination **OK**
- Line #: 2 - Target Text (from Step 4): ഞാൻ ഇരുണ്ട കാട്ടിൽ താനെ കണ്ടെത്തി, - Back-Translation (literal into the reference translation's language): I found myself in a dark forest - Reference Translation (line‑aligned): I found myself within a dark wood, - Checks (OK/FAIL): End Punct **OK**, Coverage **OK**, Meaning Drift **OK**, Comparative Orientation **N/A**, Hallucination **OK**
- Line #: 3 - Target Text (from Step 4): കാരണം ശരിയായ വഴി കാണാതായിരുന്നു. - Back-Translation (literal into the reference translation's language): because the right way was missing - Reference Translation (line‑aligned): for the right way had been missed. - Checks (OK/FAIL): End Punct **OK**, Coverage **OK**, Meaning Drift **OK**, Comparative Orientation **N/A**, Hallucination **OK**
All lines passed verification.
```malayalam ഞങ്ങളുടെ ജീവിതത്തിന്റെ വഴിയുടെ മധ്യത്തില്‍ ഞാൻ ഇരുണ്ട കാട്ടിൽ താനെ കണ്ടെത്തി, കാരണം ശരിയായ വഴി കാണാതായിരുന്നു. ```
